title: Welcome to Atlas
summary: Understand what Atlas is for, what it is not, and when to consult it before asking for institutional guidance.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

blocks.text: Atlas is the internal reference layer for MOSCATELLI. It explains standards, procedures, learning material and recurring situations; MainHub remains the place where live work is carried out and recorded.

blocks.label: Development note
blocks.text: The content in this preview validates the learning interface only and is not final policy.

items: Use Atlas when you need to understand how something should be approached.
Use MainHub when you need to act on live company work or record a current decision.
When a reference and a live record conflict, stop and raise the discrepancy rather than silently choosing one.
